title: Own credentials and own Stripe keys verification (SubmissionStatus)
caption: The component reads getCredentialSubmission every 2 s, one read at a time, until a final status; the error code and the API's message are never shown, only the portal's words.

states.label: Being verified
states.detail: "The connection keeps working as it does now."

states.label: Waiting to read again
states.detail: `RATE_LIMITED` (Retry-After ≤ 60 s), 503, 500 or the portal unreachable: a note, polling goes on.

states.label: Failed
states.detail: AMADEUS_CREDENTIALS_INVALID, STRIPE_KEY_INVALID, STRIPE_LIVEMODE_MISMATCH, PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE, TENANT_NOT_ACTIVE, CONNECTION_DISABLED, CONNECTION_CHANGED, FEATURE_DISABLED.
